summary: Every prompt the OS builds is sized on purpose: the confirmation question gets its own ~12K budget with a labelled truncation, the transport measures and caps its own input, workers pass references instead of payloads, and a measurement proves trimmed evidence still judges the same.

children.title: Size the assumption-confirmation question for what it is, not for the panel
children.spec_section: 2 — The confirmation question gets its own budget, sized for what it is
children.description: Own src/jarvis/autoreview.py, Daemon._confirmation_evidence in daemon.py with its one production caller, and the new catalog field. Do NOT edit src/jarvis/evidence.py (a test walks its AST, imports inside functions included) and do NOT touch diff_chars=150000 or anything the validation panel reads. Tests: tests/test_autoreview_confirm.py (its stub_evidence helper returns the old 2-tuple; tests/test_autoreview.py:1508 is the second caller) and tests/test_catalog.py. A sibling adds prompt-size columns and a transport ceiling — measure and cap nothing at the transport here.
children.acceptance: A confirmation question over a huge diff is shorter than the panel's 150000-char budget AND carries a truncation marker naming a dropped file that appears in the stat; both asserted in one test. Every confirmation question carries the PR link and head SHA, truncated or not, and never prints a branch name as a SHA. Full stat and full file list survive a budget that keeps no diff at all. decide_evidence scans the text actually stored.

children.title: The transport measures its own input, records it, and refuses an absurd one out loud
children.spec_section: 3 — The transport measures its own input, and refuses an absurd one out loud
children.description: Own claude_cli.run_headless_result and HeadlessResult, agent_usage.record, the two additive agent_calls columns and their ADDED_COLUMNS migration, neo_store.ask, digest.summarise's input clip, and the jarvis cost / jarvis inspect renderers (locate them with find_referencing_symbols on CentralStore.agent_calls). Measure a real maximal seat prompt before fixing the ceiling default and comment that number. Tests: test_agent_usage, test_schema_upgrade, test_transport_resilience, test_digest, test_cost_report, test_inspection. A sibling owns the confirmation budget — leave autoreview.py alone.
children.acceptance: Stored sizes equal len(prompt) and len(system_prompt) exactly. A full-sized validation round still reaches a verdict with every seat's agent_calls row — the ceiling refuses none. A refused call raises, decides nothing, leaves the question claimable and the assumption pending, and no agent_calls row claims success.

children.title: A worker passes a reference, and is refused before it pastes a payload
children.spec_section: 4 — The worker side: pass a reference, and be refused when you paste a payload
children.description: Own src/jarvis/hooks.py (the new check inside preflight_decision), concision.py, worker_brief.py and the dispatch env var. Nothing that reaches an OS-built model prompt is yours: the transport, neo_store and autoreview belong to siblings. Tests: tests/test_concision_mechanisms.py (mirror the finish-summary set), tests/test_concision.py, tests/test_worker_brief.py. Drive the whole preflight_decision entry point, never the new check alone, or a later move past the jarvis auto-allow goes unnoticed. Do not raise CORE_BUDGET_CHARS=3800; fit the rule by cutting.
children.acceptance: `jarvis neo ask proj "$(git diff)"` is denied through the real hook entry point with a message naming what to pass instead (PR URL, commit SHA, path plus line range). An oversized wo send body is denied. concision.py still imports only the standard library, pinned by a test. The hook cap and sections.QUESTION_MAX_CHARS are reconciled in a comment.

children.title: Measure that a trimmed confirmation packet judges the same as the full diff
children.spec_section: 5 — Proof: does a trimmed packet judge the same?
children.description: Call the shipped trimming path, never a budget you invent beside it. The deliverable is a measurement: touch nothing under src/jarvis/. Files: evals/llm/test_confirm_evidence_ab.py, copying the JARVIS_EVALS_LLM gating and the one-substring-cut arm discipline of evals/llm/test_house_style_ab.py and carrying pytest.mark.scenario, plus tests/test_confirm_evidence_ab_harness.py modelled on tests/test_stakes_classifier_ab_harness.py. Only the agreement number needs a real model; arm construction and scoring must be provable with fake_claude.
children.acceptance: The unsafe direction is scored separately and asserted zero: no case where the trimmed arm approves what the full arm denied or escalated. The harness test proves a hand-built deny/approve pair fails the run. Safe-direction disagreement is reported as a number, not a failure. Both arms' input sizes are reported from the recorded prompt-size columns.
